description: Reference scenario s2-four-blocks (base) on the synthetic student of fixtures/students/maya: ""I did all four blocks"". Load with env.load_seed at virtual_now 2027-03-06T10:00:00-05:00 with this binding.json and the package's fixtures/policies.json, then apply the setup in ../scenario.json.

sources.description: Courses, units, skills, prerequisites, assessments and targets written by hand for Milepost (fixtures/catalog/courses.json). Topic choice and order follow the tables of contents of three OpenStax textbooks, cited per unit and skill in that file: Elementary Algebra 2e (Lynn Marecek, MaryAnne Anthony-Smith, Andrea Honeycutt Mathis; OpenStax, Rice University, 2020; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; https://openstax.org/details/books/elementary-algebra-2e); Introductory Statistics 2e (Barbara Illowsky, Susan Dean; OpenStax, Rice University, 2023; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; https://openstax.org/details/books/introductory-statistics-2e); Biology 2e (Mary Ann Clark, Matthew Douglas, Jung Choi; OpenStax, Rice University, 2018; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; https://openstax.org/details/books/biology-2e). Names are Milepost's own wording; no text, figures or exercises from the books are included.
Hand-written student profile fixtures/profiles/maya.json: name, time zone, study preferences, weekly habits, starting strengths and learner parameters. Invented.
Starting mastery, practice sessions, the planned week and the results of past assessments, simulated from the profile with a seeded PRNG (mulberry32) and the learner rule.

Records written by hand for the scenario (examples/scenarios/s2-four-blocks/scenario.json). Both members: Monday's planned block (blk-h7) done on the platform; a plan made Monday evening with one block a day from Tuesday to Saturday. Tuesday's and Thursday's were done on the platform at their planned times; Wednesday's and Friday's have no session. Saturday's is completed by the setup event.

transformations: Catalog and profile written by hand; the generator expands them into one seed and checks it against the seed schema and validateSeed.
Results are the learner rule's level at each past assessment plus seeded noise of at most 0.05, posted two days and two hours later.
Scenario changes applied to the full fixture maya; sessions sorted by end time and blocks by start.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism, variation and reuse permissions.
